title: Saturn Swagger SS-3 operating guide
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-01; audience: public. The SS-3 uses three orbital bands suspended by Suspensium-9 gel. One sealed 12 mL cartridge powers all three bands for 47 Earth-standard minutes, provided venue gravity is from 0.40 through 1.20 g inclusive. For gravity above 1.20 through 1.60 g inclusive, install a DG-2 Dense-Gravity Collar and use the same cartridge; supported runtime is then 29 minutes. SS-3 is unsupported above 1.60 g or below 0.40 g. Do not top up a cartridge while the bands are orbiting. Pause the bands, land them, and replace the sealed cartridge. Singing to them is not a charging method.

title: Cosmic Hula SS-H operating guide
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-01; audience: public. Cosmic Hula SS-H is a single-band costume for dance floors. Its Suspensium-8 foam pack lasts 83 minutes in 0.80–1.10 g venues. It is not a Saturn Swagger SS-3 accessory. Suspensium-8 foam cannot be loaded into an SS-3 gel cartridge. SS-H does not support the DG-2 collar. A rotating band is not automatically a compatible rotating band.

title: Dense-Gravity Collar recall notice
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-18; audience: public; authority: safety notice. DG-2 collars with lot code DG2-Q17 are recalled. Affected collars can briefly invert ring orientation when exposed to applause. Stop using the affected collar and request a free replacement; this is a safety recall, not a discretionary return. Collars with lot code DG2-Q71 are not covered by this recall. A customer's height, number of hands, or ability to clap silently does not change the recall scope.

title: Milky Way Day venue checklist
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-20; audience: public. Mosslight Pavilion runs at 1.35 g during Milky Way Day celebrations. Cloudbladder Hall runs at 0.70 g. Both venues allow Saturn Swagger SS-3 costumes, subject to the SS-3 operating guide and current safety notices. Mosslight's venue booking does not include a DG-2 collar. The DJ's gravity jokes are not calibrated measurements.

title: Public costume return policy
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-01; audience: public; authority: policy. Unopened costume purchases may be returned within 19 Earth-standard days of delivery. Opened Suspensium-9 cartridges are not returnable under this discretionary policy. Safety recall remedies remain available regardless of this return window. Rentals have a separate policy. Starting a new orbit does not restart the return period.

title: Neptune Mood-Mist NM-7 quick start
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-01; audience: public. NM-7 uses Brinewink capsules, not Suspensium gel or Venus atmosphere pods. A capsule provides 64 minutes of mood mist. School mode suppresses the cape's spoken weather insults but does not change capsule life. The NM-7 Quiet Clip enables school mode. The NM-1 Quiet Clip has a different connector and is incompatible.

title: Venus Atmospheric Drama VA-6 refill guide
content: Status: current; effective 2026-09-01; audience: public. VA-6 uses Sulfurless Sigh pods, yielding 38 minutes of theatrical atmosphere. These pods are incompatible with Neptune NM-7. Their packaging says ‘mist refill,’ but that phrase is not a cross-product compatibility guarantee. Vaping a refill voids the product warranty and the conversation.

title: Green Visitor GV-1 costume — demo product catalog
content: Status: current; audience: public. Fictional demo product: Green Visitor GV-1, a green alien UFO costume with a large green head, saucer-shaped waist, and silver legs. A playful choice for an alien-themed party. Decorative costume only: the saucer does not fly, levitate, or provide protective equipment. It is not the Saturn Swagger SS-3 and has no orbital bands or Suspensium cartridge. The attached real photograph is an illustrative reference, not an actual manufactured product or an endorsement. No price, stock, size, or delivery information is available.
